messages.content: Should I put all my savings in crypto?

That's a significant financial decision and I'd encourage caution. Crypto is highly volatile — some assets have lost 80–90% of value in short windows. Most financial advisors suggest it constitute a small portion of a diversified portfolio if at all. It'd be worth speaking to a licensed financial advisor about your specific situation.
